Add missing fields to SpecReport JSON marshalling, and add unit test

ci: default the release bump so a mobile dispatch can't send it empty (#1688)

The bump choice input had no default.  The GitHub web UI submits the
first option anyway, but the mobile app dispatched the run with an empty
bump, which failed scripts/release.sh only after the full test run.

Default to patch, mark the input required, check it in a job that runs
before the tests, and put the bump in the run name.  Also fix a typo in
the Unreleased changelog entry.

Precompile the fixture in the suite-timeout integration test (#1689)

ginkgo's --timeout clock starts before it compiles the suite.  On a
loaded CI runner, compiling the hanging fixture could eat most of the 5s
timeout, so the spec never printed "Sleeping..." and the test failed.  It
has flaked this way on master four times since August.

Build the fixture first, as the neighbouring interrupt test already does,
then run the precompiled binary with the timeout.
